overall_assessment: Track 25 adheres strictly to Searchright open science governance and repository handoff policies. Review bundle packaging in scripts/review_bundle.py enforces self-describing, deterministic ZIP archives (.srpack) with fixed epoch timestamps (1980-01-01 00:00:00), Merkle root verification over entry descriptor digests, SHA-256 payload digests, and default-deny execution policies (no network, no symlinks, no external writes, mandatory secret scanning). Path traversal attacks are deterministically blocked via safe_destination. The research object handoff plan schema (contracts/json-schema/research-object-handoff-plan.v1.schema.json) and fixture (contracts/examples/research-object-handoff-plan.json) strictly enforce non-negotiable governance invariants: 'execution_mode: dry_run', 'deposit_authorized: false', 'ro_crate_conformance_claimed: false', and 'osf_acceptance_claimed: false' via JSON Schema 'const: false' constraints. Automated deposit is prohibited by contract. All repository governance tests in test_provenance_research_objects_governance.py and review_bundle.py self-test pass with zero errors.

findings.description: The research object handoff plan schema strictly requires deposit_authorized: false, ro_crate_conformance_claimed: false, and osf_acceptance_claimed: false as schema constants, preventing unapproved live deposit claims at the contract level.
findings.recommendation: Retain schema-enforced dry_run and false-claim invariants across all future repository integration specifications.

findings.description: scripts/review_bundle.py self-test executes a four-part verification suite (deterministic_bytes, payload_verification, tamper_rejection, secret_rejection) verifying bitwise bundle immutability and instant detection of modified payload bytes.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the offline, standard-library-only self-test suite as a mandatory pre-commit check.

findings.description: Safe destination enforcement rejects empty paths, directory traversal ('../'), absolute paths, and reserved directories ('.git/'), guaranteeing unpack sandbox safety.
findings.recommendation: Ensure archive extractors downstream adopt the identical safe destination sanitizer.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Review bundle Merkle root descriptor calculations and SHA-256 content hashes verified by review_bundle.py self-test.
Default-deny repository handoff plan contracts, dry-run enforcement, secret rejection, and prohibition of automatic deposit verified.
Self-test suite, bundle packaging determinism, payload tampering rejection, and schema validation pass 100%.

calibration_notes: Open science governance auditors verify that dry-run boundaries, review bundle self-test integrity, secret rejection, and default-deny repository deposit policies are fully enforced by contracts and tests.
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only. Review bundle determinism, self-verification, secret detection, and default-deny handoff contracts are verified; live repository deposit to OSF or Zenodo remains unapproved and requires explicit out-of-band human authorization.
